caption:
When bookings slow down, most owners reach for the same lever: a bigger ad budget.

Before you touch your spend, run this test. Pull your last 20 leads. Check how fast each one got a first response, and whether it got more than one follow-up attempt.

If your average response time runs past a few minutes, or most leads got exactly one touch and then silence, that's your leak. More ad spend only pours more leads into it.

Fix the follow-up system first. Scale the budget once it holds.

Want Black Arrow to find the leak in your pipeline and build the fix?

rationale: Research confirms contrarian, specific-scene hooks win B2B reel completion right now, and this reframes the brand's growth thesis around a concrete 20-lead diagnostic instead of the ad-spend-envy, hire-vs-automate, or cost-creep angles already shipped.
